== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Dornoth]] III is a planet located within the [[Dornoth system]]. Its appearance is characterized by a purple surface that is encased in a network of satellites and metal stations, giving it the appearance of being imprisoned. Despite this infrastructure, the planet lacks any colonies because its volcanic activity releases corrosive substances that reach into space. The planet is unpredictable and can pose a threat to its own orbital structures through heat, acid clouds, or high-speed debris. During combat operations, the planet's atmosphere has been known to glow green from artillery fire, and it has previously experienced massive explosions that destroyed half of its surface.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Dornoth]] III is a purple-surfaced sister planet to [[Dornoth IV]], characterized by its entrapment within various metal stations and satellites. The location serves as a site where Aila Escalon{{!}}Aila's clones have been seen hovering amidst clouds that lit up green from the impact of ordnance. Within its upper atmosphere, Sola Kalter{{!}}Sola's shots and the [[Zenith Blade]] pop into normal time. Additionally, the entity can be surrounded by eyes conjured by [[Horizon]].}}
